name: MinIO
summary: List, fetch and publish objects in a self-hosted MinIO server or cluster through its S3-compatible API, at an endpoint you set.

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.label: Access key
fields.help: A MinIO user's access key; prefer a service account over the root user.

fields.name: session_token
fields.label: Session token
fields.help: Only for temporary credentials from the MinIO STS.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Endpoint host
settings.help: Host name or address of the server or load balancer, without the port.

egress.note: 9000 is the MinIO API default; behind a TLS proxy the port is usually 443. The console on 9001 is not used.

operators.summary: List keys under a prefix, with sizes and ETags, as a manifest.
Fetch objects into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under a key prefix with multipart upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Requests use path-style addressing, which MinIO accepts without further server configuration.
